name: Equifax Inc
sector: Financials — consumer credit reporting & verification data (SIC 7320)
moat_justification: Regulated bureau triopoly plus The Work Number's dominant payroll-verification database (antitrust plaintiffs allege >40% exclusive control of VOIE payroll data) and 51.5% Workforce Solutions EBITDA margins show real pricing power; capped at 7 because measured ROIC ran only 7.15–10.37% over 2021–25 (goodwill-heavy denominator and trough-depressed numerator — see analysis.md) and operating margin compressed from 23.1% to 18.0%.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 8.51 vs 3-yr median 5.86 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 5.2x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
HIGH_NET_DEBT: net debt is 4.7x normalized OE — levered OE can vanish fast; stress the bear cases
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.3%) vs bull-case tier C (12.2%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: Real moat (7/10) but cyclical and levered — on TTM OE of $8.45/share it does not clear 15% at $160.85 (weighted IRR 9.94%, IV@15 $91.61); it clears 15% only at or below $91.61.
moat_for: One of only three national credit bureaus — data files no entrant can replicate
The Work Number payroll database embedded in mortgage, auto and government verification workflows
Segment pricing power: FY2025 adj. EBITDA margins 51.5% Workforce Solutions, 35.2% USIS
Switching costs — lender models and employer HR/payroll processes built around its data
moat_against: Measured ROIC only 7–10% through the cycle; operating margin compressed 23.1% → 18.0%
VOIE antitrust suit survived dismissal; tri-merge elimination would cut bureau-pull volumes
FICO direct licensing and FHFA VantageScore opening re-route score economics
Mortgage and hiring cyclicality — OE/share fell to $0.57 in 2022
Payroll-data challengers (Argyle et al.) attacking Work Number exclusivity
